extracted.intended_audience: stem-cell, organoid and virology researchers (academic biomedical researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and procedural criteria for culturing human pluripotent stem cells, differentiating them to lung and colonic organoids, performing viral infections, sequencing and data analysis, and reporting reproducible in vitro, in vivo and human-subject experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication and mycoplasma testing of human ES cell lines
rubrics_metrics.description: All human ES cell lines were authenticated by short tandem repeat profiling and tested for mycoplasma contamination every six months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly report authentication method and frequency of mycoplasma testing (here: STR profiling; every six months).

rubrics_metrics.name: hPSC culture conditions reported in detail
rubrics_metrics.description: RUES2 human embryonic stem (ES) cells were cultured on irradiated mouse embryonic fibroblasts at a density of 20,000–25,000 cells cm−2 in DMEM/F12, 20% knockout serum replacement, 0.1 mM β-mercaptoethanol and 20 ng ml−1 bFGF, medium changed daily; maintained at 37 °C in 5% CO2 until ~90% confluence. H1 and HUES8 were grown on 1% Matrigel in StemFlex medium at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report exact substrate, plating density, medium composition (including supplements and concentrations), incubation temperature and gas composition, and medium-change frequency.

rubrics_metrics.name: hPSC lung differentiation protocol parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Stepwise concentrations, timings and media for differentiation to lung progenitors and mature lung cells are specified (e.g., endoderm induction with 10 μM Y-27632, 0.5 ng ml−1 BMP4, 2.5 ng ml−1 bFGF and 100 ng ml−1 activin A for 72–76 h; anterior foregut endoderm induction with dorsomorphin and SB431542; early lung progenitors treated with 3 μM CHIR99021, 10 ng ml−1 FGF10, 10 ng ml−1 KGF, 10 ng ml−1 BMP4 and 50–60 nM ATRA; later stage compositions and 3D Matrigel embedding for maturation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document exact reagent identities, concentrations, durations, culture formats (2D vs 3D), and environmental conditions for each differentiation stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: hPSC colonic lineage differentiation parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitive endoderm induction and hindgut/colonic induction conditions are specified (e.g., 3 μM CHIR99021 and 100 ng ml−1 activin A; hindgut: 3 μM CHIR99021 and 500 ng ml−1 FGF4 with RPMI1640 + B27; colonic induction with 100 ng ml−1 BMP2, 3 μM CHIR99021 and 100 ng ml−1 hEGF; maturation medium compositions and refresh schedules; passaging every 10–14 days at 1:6 ratio).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide exact stepwise reagent regimens, embedding/passaging procedures, medium refresh intervals and expansion ratios for organoid protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: BSL‑3 biosafety and facility compliance for live SARS‑CoV‑2 work
rubrics_metrics.description: All work involving live SARS‑CoV‑2 was performed in the CDC/USDA‑approved BSL‑3 facility of the Global Health and Emerging Pathogens Institute at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai in accordance with institutional biosafety requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the biosafety level, facility approvals (CDC/USDA or equivalent), and that procedures conformed to institutional biosafety requirements when handling live virus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal experiment approvals, housing and randomization/blinding
rubrics_metrics.description: All animal work was conducted in agreement with NIH guidelines and approved by the Weill Cornell Medicine Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee and the Institutional Biosafety Committee. Mice were maintained at 22 °C with 40–60% humidity and a 12 light/12 dark cycle; mice were randomly separated into different groups and researchers analysing the data were blind to treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report IACUC/IBC approval, housing conditions, randomization procedures and blinding for data analysis; include mouse strain and ages used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Xenograft experimental parameters and dosing regimen
rubrics_metrics.description: One million hPSC-derived lung progenitor cells (day 25) were subcutaneously injected into 6–8‑week‑old NSG mice. For in vivo drug evaluation mice were treated with 400 mg kg−1 imatinib mesylate, 50 mg kg−1 MPA and 25 mg kg−1 QNHC in 10% DMSO/90% corn oil by intraperitoneal injection; four hours after drug administration, SARS‑CoV‑2‑entry virus was inoculated directly to the xenograft at 1 × 10^3 FFUs; mice euthanized at 24 hpi for analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report cell number injected, mouse strain/age/sex, drug formulation/doses/routes/timing relative to infection, inoculum dose, and timepoints for euthanasia and analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects approvals, consent and tissue handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Tissue samples were provided under IRB‑approved protocols; experiments using human samples were conducted in accordance with local regulations and IRB approval. Autopsy samples were collected under a specified IRB protocol and consent is not required for autopsy samples per that protocol; colonoscopy tissues were collected with informed consent under a specific IRB protocol. Tissue specimens were fixed in 10% formalin or 2.5% glutaraldehyde for 48–72 h before subsequent procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report IRB protocol numbers, consent status for each sample type, local regulatory compliance, and fixation conditions used for human tissue specimens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immunohistochemistry/immunofluorescence reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: For immunofluorescence, cells or tissue sections were immunostained with primary antibodies at 4 °C overnight and secondary antibodies at room temperature for 1 h; nuclei counterstained by DAPI. Primary and secondary antibody information provided in Supplementary Table 3.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide incubation temperatures and times, antibody catalogue/clone/dilution information, counterstains used, and reference to supplementary antibody tables; report image processing software.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intracellular flow cytometry staining protocol
rubrics_metrics.description: Flow cytometry intracellular staining followed the Fixation/Permeabilization Solution Kit instructions: fixation at 4 °C for 20 min, wash twice in Perm/Wash buffer, incubate with primary antibody at 4 °C for 30 min in the dark, wash twice then incubate with secondary antibody at 4 °C for 30 min in the dark, wash twice before analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report fixation/permeabilization reagents, temperatures, incubation durations, and washes; reference kit or manufacturer instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Western blot reagent and detection reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Protein was extracted in RIPA lysis buffer with protease inhibitors before safe removal from BSL‑3. Proteins separated by SDS–PAGE, transferred to nitrocellulose, probed with specified primary antibodies (with clones and dilutions listed) and detected with fluorophore‑conjugated secondary antibodies; fluorescence detected on LI‑COR Odyssey CLx and analysed with Image Studio software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report lysis buffer composition, antibody identities and dilutions, detection system, and analysis software.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: SPR was performed at 25 °C in HBS‑EP+ buffer (10 mM HEPES pH 7.4; 150 mM NaCl; 3.4 mM EDTA; 0.005% P20). Human ACE2 diluted to 50 μg ml−1 in 10 mM sodium acetate pH 4.5 was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip using amine coupling; blank flow cell used as reference. 1.5‑fold dilutions of compounds from 30 to 1.17 μM were injected; surface regenerated with 10 mM glycine pH 1.5; background binding subtracted and binding calculated using Biacore T200 evaluation software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report temperature, buffer composition, immobilization chemistry, reference subtraction, dilution series, regeneration conditions, and analysis software for SPR experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: qRT–PCR assay design and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: One‑step quantitative real‑time PCR performed using SuperScript III Platinum SYBR Green One‑Step qRT–PCR Kit with primers specific for TRS‑L and TRS‑B sites for N gene and ACTB as internal reference; reactions run on LightCycler 480; ΔΔCT determined relative to ACTB and mock‑infected/treated samples; error bars indicate SD from three biological replicates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State kit, primer targets, internal control gene, instrument, normalization method (ΔΔCT), number of biological replicates and how error bars are calculated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single‑cell suspension preparation and sorting for scRNA‑seq
rubrics_metrics.description: Organoids dissociated to single cells with trypsin, neutralized, pelleted, resuspended in L15 + HEPES + DNaseI, filtered through 40‑μm filter, stained with DAPI and live cells sorted by ARIA II flow cytometer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report dissociation enzyme and conditions, neutralization, buffer composition, filtration step, viability stain, and cell sorting hardware/method.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10x Chromium loading targets and library prep reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: 10,000 cells loaded into each channel of the Single‑Cell A Chip to target 8,000 cells. Chromium Single Cell 3′ Reagent Kit v3 used; cDNA amplification, fragmentation, adaptor ligation, and final library QC by Bioanalyzer; sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq with paired‑end 100 cycle kit (28+8+91).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report target cell loading numbers, kit and version, library construction steps, QC method and sequencing instrument and read configuration.

rubrics_metrics.name: scRNA‑seq pre‑processing and Cell Ranger pipeline
rubrics_metrics.description: FASTQ files imported to 10x Cell Ranger v3.0.2; cellranger mkfastq demultiplexed and generated .fastq; cellranger count aligned fastq to reference genome and extracted gene expression UMI count matrix. Custom reference built for viral genes and luciferase by integrating sequences into GRCh38 using cellranger mkref.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify Cell Ranger version, mkfastq/count steps, and if a custom reference was built (and how viral genes were integrated).

rubrics_metrics.name: scRNA‑seq cell and gene filtering criteria (hPSC‑COs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter out cells with fewer than 300 or more than 8,000 genes detected and cells with mitochondrial gene content > 30%; use remaining cells for downstream analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report explicit thresholds used for gene counts per cell and mitochondrial content for inclusion/exclusion of cells.

rubrics_metrics.name: scRNA‑seq normalization and highly variable gene selection (hPSC‑COs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Normalized UMI counts per sample separately using scran deconvolution (quickCluster, computeSumFactors, rescaling), log transform, multiBatchNorm across samples; identified highly variable genes via Seurat FindVariableFeatures, selected top 3,000 variable genes after excluding mitochondrial, ribosomal and dissociation‑related genes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report normalization method, clustering for size factor computation, how batch normalization was done, the HVG method, the number of HVGs selected and explicit exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Batch correction, dimensionality reduction and clustering for scRNA‑seq (hPSC‑COs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Aligned samples using mutual nearest neighbours (fastMNN) by performing PCA on HVGs and correcting PCs; selected corrected top 50 PCs for downstream visualization and clustering; RunUMAP with training epochs set to 2,000; clustered into eight clusters using shared‑nearest‑neighbour graph via FindNeighbours and FindClusters (resolution 0.2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report batch correction method (fastMNN), number of PCs used post‑correction, UMAP training epochs, clustering algorithm and resolution parameter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marker identification and cluster curation for scRNA‑seq
rubrics_metrics.description: Identified marker genes for each cluster via FindMarkers comparing cells inside vs outside cluster; reviewed clusters and merged clusters judged to be from the same population; selected top marker genes (e.g., top 10) per cluster for heatmap plotting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe marker detection method, criteria for manual/biological review and cluster merging, and how marker lists for visualization were chosen.

rubrics_metrics.name: scRNA‑seq filtering and analysis parameters (lung organoids)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filtered cells with fewer than 200 or more than 6,000 UMIs, removed genes detected in fewer than two cells, excluded cells with >30% mitochondrial sequences; normalized with Seurat NormalizeData; selected top 3,000 variable genes via vst method; used an elbow plot to choose top 20 PCs; scaled data, ran RunPCA, clustered at resolution 0.2 and annotated clusters via FindAllMarkers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the specific UMI and mitochondrial cutoffs, gene detection filters, HVG selection method, PC selection approach (elbow plot), clustering resolution and marker identification method.

rubrics_metrics.name: RNA‑seq library prep, alignment and visualization standards
rubrics_metrics.description: RNA‑seq libraries of polyadenylated RNA were prepared using TruSeq RNA Library Prep Kit v2 or TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit; sequenced on Illumina NextSeq 500; reads aligned to the SARS‑CoV‑2/human genome using Bowtie2 and visualized with IGV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State library kit used, sequencing platform, alignment tool and genome reference, and visualization software used for QC/inspection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differential expression analysis thresholds and tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Used edgeR to calculate RPKM and log2[counts per million] matrices and to perform differential expression; volcano plots indicate differentially expressed genes with P‑adjusted value < 0.05 and log2[fold change] > 1 highlighted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report statistical package used for DE (edgeR), how expression values were computed, multiple‑test adjusted P‑value cutoff and fold‑change threshold used to define significant genes.

rubrics_metrics.name: High‑throughput chemical screening design and hit quantification
rubrics_metrics.description: hPSC‑LOs plated at 10,000 cells per 40 μl in 384‑well plates; compounds from FDA‑approved library added at 10 μM; DMSO negative control; infected with SARS‑CoV‑2‑entry virus MOI = 0.01; luciferase assay readout at 24 hpi. EC50 calculated by normalizing luciferase to DMSO; CC50 determined by Cell‑Titer Glo normalized to DMSO; curves calculated using Prism GraphPad 7.0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document seeding density, plate type, compound concentration, control conditions, infection MOI and timepoints, assay readouts, normalization methods for efficacy/toxicity and software used for curve fitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequencing data and code availability reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: RNA‑seq and scRNA‑seq data deposited in GEO with accession numbers (GSE155241, GSE148113, GSE147975, GSE151803); source data provided with the paper. Code for processing scRNA‑seq data available on GitHub at specified URL.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide public repository accession numbers for raw/processed data and a URL or repo for analysis code to enable reproducibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electron microscopy sample preparation and staining
rubrics_metrics.description: After osmium tetroxide post‑fixation and gradient dehydration, semi‑thin sections examined, thin sections cut and stained with uranyl acetate and lead citrate; grids viewed with a transmission electron microscope.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report fixation/post‑fixation, dehydration, sectioning and heavy metal staining steps used for EM imaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical reporting and reproducibility conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: No statistical methods were used to predetermine sample size. n = 3 independent biological replicates were used for all experiments unless otherwise indicated. P values were calculated by unpaired two‑tailed Student’s t‑tests unless otherwise indicated. *P < 0.05; **P < 0.01; ***P < 0.001. Each experiment was repeated independently three times with similar results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state sample size rationale (or lack thereof), number of biological replicates, statistical test(s) used, significance notation, and whether experiments were independently repeated with consistent results.
